verses.ar:
صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ يَا عَدْنَانِي
يَا مُصْطَفَى يَا صَفْوَةَ الرَّحْمٰنِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي أَعْطَانِي
هَذَا الْغُلَامَ الطَّيِّبَ الْأَرْدَانِ (2)
verses.tr:
Ṣallā ʿalayka-llāhu yā ʿAdnānī
Yā Muṣṭafā yā ṣafwata-r-Raḥmān
Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī aʿṭānī
Hādha-l-ghulāma-ṭ-ṭayyiba-l-ardān (2)
verses.en: May Allah's blessing be upon you, O son of Adnan — O Chosen One, O purest of the Most Merciful's creation! Praise belongs to Allah, who granted me this good child, pure from the very cradle.

verses.ar:
قَدْ سَادَ فِي الْمَهْدِ عَلَى الْغِلْمَانِ
أُعِيذُهُ بِالْبَيْتِ ذِي الْأَرْكَانِ
حَتَّى أَرَاهُ بَالِغَ الْبُنْيَانِ
أَنْتَ الَّذِي سُمِّيتَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ (2)
verses.tr:
Qad sāda fi-l-mahdi ʿala-l-ghilmāni
Uʿīdhuhu bi-l-bayti dhi-l-arkāni
Ḥattā arāhu bāligha-l-bunyāni
Anta-lladhī summīta fi-l-Qurʾān (2)
verses.en: Even in the cradle he surpassed every other child; I place him in the protection of the House of firm foundations, until I see him grown to full stature — you are the one named in the Qur'an.

verses.ar:
أَحْمَدُ مَكْتُوبٌ عَلَى الْجِنَانِ
صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ فِي الْأَحْيَانِ
أَحْمَدُهُ فِي السِّرِّ وَالْبُرْهَانِ
حَقًّا عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَالْإِيمَانِ (2)
verses.tr:
Aḥmadu maktūbun ʿala-l-jināni
Ṣallā ʿalayka-llāhu fi-l-aḥyāni
Aḥmaduhu fi-s-sirri wa-l-burhāni
Ḥaqqan ʿala-l-islāmi wa-l-īmāni (2)
verses.en: Ahmad — his name is inscribed upon the gardens of Paradise; may Allah's blessing be upon you always. I praise him in private and in evidence, truly, for the sake of Islam and faith.

verses.ar:
يَا رَبَّنَا بِالْمُصْطَفَى الْعَدْنَانِي
اغْفِرْ ذُنُوبِي ثُمَّ أَصْلِحْ شَانِي (2)
verses.tr:
Yā Rabbanā bi-l-Muṣṭafā-l-ʿAdnānī
Ighfir dhunūbī thumma aṣliḥ shānī (2)
verses.en: O our Lord, by the Chosen One, the son of Adnan, forgive my sins and set my affairs right.
